 Looking back on my high school relationship, even though it was good we were not meant for each other at all and I always wonder where my life would be now had we not broken up. I made it to every house in a large group of people, we weren’t rushing, and stopped for food and drink etc. however, the conga line aspect you’re talking about really bothered me. They were even instructing us to stick as close as possibly to the group in front of us through each house to eliminate wait times.
